observations.limitations: The examples establish food-sauce uses but do not define the full consistency range.
observations.observation: The article names “saus keju,” “saus tomat,” “saus sambal,” and sauces served with siomay, bakso, and noodles.

observations.limitations: It supports natural generic and specific use, not a measured claim of nationwide normality; “sambal” and “kecap” also name particular condiments.
observations.observation: The article uses both generic “saus” and specific expressions such as “saus tomat” and “saus kacang.”
observations.source_title: Kenali Anak dengan Sindroma Nefrotik dan Diet Sehatnya

observations.limitations: A regulatory product list is not evidence of conversational frequency.
observations.observation: Food categories include “saus cabe,” “saus tomat,” “saus tiram,” and other named sauces, alongside “sambal.”
